headline: Ironwood Logistics to present at regional manufacturing conference
body: Ironwood Logistics will present on supply chain practices at a regional conference in Leipzig. Executives are scheduled to take questions from attendees.

headline: Ironwood Logistics cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Ironwood Logistics lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Ironwood Logistics wins quality award from industry association
body: Ironwood Logistics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Ironwood Logistics on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Ironwood Logistics, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.

headline: Ironwood Logistics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Ironwood Logistics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Ironwood Logistics appoints new regional sales director
body: Ironwood Logistics announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Ironwood Logistics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Ironwood Logistics reported revenue growth of 22% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Court freezes assets of Ironwood Logistics amid insolvency petition
body: A court froze assets of Ironwood Logistics after creditors filed an insolvency petition. Operations continue under court supervision.
